blockers.detail: Archive original raster/point-cloud delivery, metadata and source hashes.
Document horizontal datum, realization, epoch and coordinate transformation.
Verify the delivery-specific vertical datum and geoid transformation.
Provide valid measured coverage for the complete declared scope and retain its mask.
Measure the rendered surface against its reference and meet the mesh error allocation.
A sampled maximum is not a validated bound across the declared scope.
Supply independent survey report and control observations; DEM-derived control does not qualify.
0/30 minimum independent controls supplied.
0/4 scope quadrants have control.
Controls must span at least the required fraction of both horizontal axes.
Controls do not cover the required elevation range.
Missing surveyed classes: open, steep, runout.
Horizontal error plus survey uncertainty exceeds tolerance or is unknown.
Vertical error plus survey uncertainty exceeds tolerance or is unknown.

note: Evidence declarations require independent inspection of their referenced artifacts, datum alignment and sampling design. This engineering gate never issues a survey certificate.
